This '''reptiloid race''' had large frills on their necks and broad tails. A [[Unidentified New Republic reptilian diplomat|member]] of this species was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] diplomat.

==Behind the scenes==
This species was illustrated by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] for ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', published by [[Chronicle Books]] in [[2001]]. They resemble members of the [[Viis Empire]], from the [[W:c:lucasfilm:Alien Chronicles|''Alien Chronicles'']] series also illustrated by Whitlatch.<ref name="AE">{{WebCite|url=http://www.lucasaliens.com/israi_bg.html|text=THE VIIS - Israi|archivedate=20050209071132}}</ref>
